items.title: Israel says new head of Hamas' military wing killed in Gaza City strikes
items.description: At least three people were killed in the attacks, which came despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

items.title: Dozens killed in Lebanon as Israel intensifies strikes
items.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" the Iran-backed group.

items.title: Nasa unveils next steps to build permanent Moon base
items.description: Nasa plans to send hopping drones and roving vehicles to the Moon as part of plans for a permanent Moon base.

items.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
items.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

items.title: Can EU find a Russia whisperer to mediate an end to war in Ukraine?
items.description: With the US pulling out of trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine, the EU is looking for potential candidates to step in.

items.title: One killed and nine missing after chemical explosion at US paper mill
items.description: Nine others were injured and another nine are missing after a tank ruptured at a paper mill in Longview, Washington.

items.title: Hotels can refuse to give tap water to tourists, Italy's top court rules
items.description: The Italian Supreme Court rejected a tourist's claim that her consumer rights were breached when she was only offered €7 bottled mineral water.

items.title: Trump-backed challenger beats veteran US senator in Texas primary
items.description: The result sets up what will be a closely watched contest in November with Paxton's Democratic opponent.

items.title: YouTuber arrested for allegedly using AI to defame Korean actor
items.description: The YouTuber allegedly made false claims that fuelled a career-ending scandal for Kim Soo-hyun.

items.title: First Ghanaians set to be repatriated from South Africa over anti-immigrant protests
items.description: It follows recent protests that have led to fears there could be a resurgence in xenophobic violence.

items.title: Russia 'relentlessly targeting' critical infrastructure and democracy, GCHQ says
items.description: The spy agency's head will set out threats facing the UK and the measures she believes need to be taken to confront them on Wednesday.

items.title: Major film union in India calls for boycott of superstar Ranveer Singh
items.description: Singh is facing industry backlash over his decision to exit from the upcoming Bollywood film Don 3.
